name: Sistema di Interscambio (SdI) - direct (SDICoop)

sandbox.notes: 'Implemented-awaiting-accreditation': a real SDICoop SOAP client exists (sdicoop-client.ts), but Partita IVA registration on Entratel plus AdE-issued certificates (collaudo) are required to actually reach the real service -- documentation/docs/developer-guide/credentials-guide.md item 4 status is Repo: RED (missing).

provenance.sourceText: documentation/docs/developer-guide/credentials-guide.md item 4: "SdI (SDICoop/SDIFTP) | Italy | (missing) | Partita IVA on Entratel + channel accreditation (collaudo)"; sdi-transport.ts's own header: 'no POLLER is registered for this id (e.g. "sdi" - push-only SOAP notifiche, see conformity/pollers/'s own header)'.

notes: Italy's OWN mandatory clearance system, not a commercial vendor -- exactly one operator for the accredited/direct route (SDICoop), distinct from the sdi-pec legal channel (a certified-email route to the SAME underlying SdI network, needing no accreditation at all -- see sdi-pec-transport.ts). capabilities.lifecycleStatuses is false: SdI pushes notifiche to the accredited channel itself rather than exposing a pollable status endpoint this codebase follows.
